department: Anatomical Sciences and Neurobiology (School of Medicine)

deadline.value: All materials must be received by January 15 for Fall entry; review begins December 15.
deadline.quote: All materials must be received by January 15

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is listed under optional documents, alongside optional MCAT scores.
gre_general.quote: Official scores on the Graduate record Exam (GRE) General Test

gre_subject.value: The catalog does not mention a Psychology GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree before admission.

funding.value: Admitted School of Medicine PhD students receive a 23-month fellowship, followed by mentor, department or grant support.
funding.quote: Students admitted to one of the School of Medicine’s PhD Programs receive a comprehensive 23-month fellowship

also.quote: Students accepted into the PhD program will be considered for an IPIBS graduate student fellowship

entry_route.value: A bachelor's from an accredited college is enough; no specific major is required.
entry_route.quote: The degree program is available to qualified individuals possessing a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog Anatomical Sciences and Neurobiology PhD section; the School of Medicine PhD admissions page confirms the January 15 deadline and 23-month fellowship for School of Medicine PhDs. Admission is described as competitive and limited to fall entry.
